speedster.briefing: Full speed into ramps (need 1.9 m/s). Fire piston at 30-38m gap. Ease for log at 22-30m. Camera scans survivors at 4, 19m;
speedster.rationale: Camera covers both survivors and ultrasonic covers the structure, so both stay. The 0.9 m gap has no ramp, so a piston is needed. The small battery is risky with the piston and sensors drawing power, so I swapped to the large one. A bumper halves the log damage.

partsWhy.why: Only way across the 0.9 m gap with no ramp.
Small pack could run dry; a DNF scores nothing.
Halves damage from the log impact and any rough landing.
Only sensor that scans the structure at 42 m; also spots the log.

mud_crawler.briefing: Full speed on ramps (14-22m, 50-58m). Fire piston at 0.9m gap (30-38m). Slow past survivors at 4m, 19m and structure at 42m.
mud_crawler.rationale: No water, so the case is dropped. The camera scans survivors and the ultrasonic scans the structure at 42 m. The piston clears the 0.9 m gap and the bumper cushions the log. The brushless motor tops 2.5 m/s, enough for the 1.9 m/s ramp. The large battery is kept.

partsWhy.why: Only way over the 0.9 m gap with no ramp.
Scans both survivors, at 4 m and 19 m.
Only sensor that scans the cracked structure at 42 m.
2.5 m/s top speed clears the 1.9 m/s ramp requirement.

all_rounder.briefing: Full speed into both ramps (need 1.7 and 1.9 m/s). Slow for the 4 cm log at 22-30m. Fire piston at the 0.9m gap at 30m. Scan at 4, 19, 42m.
all_rounder.rationale: All-rounder plus a piston for the 0.9 m gap with no ramp. The motor is swapped for the brushless one because the torque motor tops out at 2 m/s, too close to the 1.9 m/s ramp need. Camera and ultrasonic cover all three scan zones. The bumper limits log damage.

partsWhy.why: Clears the 0.9 m gap at 30-38 m, which has no ramp.
2.5 m/s top speed gives margin for the 1.7 and 1.9 m/s ramps.
Scans both survivors at 4 m and 19 m.
The only sensor that scans the cracked structure at 42 m.

deep_diver.briefing: Full speed on ramps (need 1.9 m/s). Fire piston at the 30 m gap edge. Slow for log at 22-30 m.
deep_diver.rationale: There is no water, so the case and thrusters are dead weight. The piston is for the 0.9 m gap at 30 m. The bumper covers the log. Off-road wheels suit the grass and clear the log. The faster motor helps with the 1.9 m/s ramp. Camera and ultrasonic cover all scans.

partsWhy.why: Jumps the 0.9 m gap that has no ramp.
Grip on the grass stretches and more clearance for the 4 cm log.
2.5 m/s top speed gives margin for the 1.9 m/s ramp.
Halves the damage from the log impact.
